command:
set -eu
command -v mkfs.xfs >/dev/null
command -v fallocate >/dev/null
getenforce | grep -qx Enforcing
if ! id archiveapp >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd --system --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /sbin/nologin archiveapp
fi
install -d -o root -g root -m 0750 /var/lib/archive-storage
truncate -s 768M /var/lib/archive-storage/archive-volume.img
chown root:root /var/lib/archive-storage/archive-volume.img
chmod 0600 /var/lib/archive-storage/archive-volume.img
mkfs.xfs -f -L archive-data /var/lib/archive-storage/archive-volume.img >/dev/null
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /srv/archive
if ! grep -Fq '/var/lib/archive-storage/archive-volume.img /srv/archive ' /etc/fstab; then
  printf '%s\n' '/var/lib/archive-storage/archive-volume.img /srv/archive xfs loop,nofail,nodev,nosuid,noexec 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
mount /srv/archive
mountpoint -q /srv/archive
findmnt -n -o FSTYPE /srv/archive | grep -qx xfs
install -d -o archiveapp -g archiveapp -m 0750 /srv/archive/incoming
install -d -o archiveapp -g archiveapp -m 0750 /srv/archive/records
printf '%s\n' 'existing archive manifest: preserve during capacity recovery' > /srv/archive/records/manifest.db
chown archiveapp:archiveapp /srv/archive/records/manifest.db
chmod 0640 /srv/archive/records/manifest.db
install -d -o root -g root -m 0700 /srv/archive/.telemetry-cache
install -o root -g root -m 0600 /dev/null /srv/archive/.telemetry-cache/collector-debug.capture
restorecon -RF /var/lib/archive-storage /srv/archive

set -eu
target=/srv/archive/.telemetry-cache/collector-debug.capture
available_kib="$(df -Pk /srv/archive | awk 'NR == 2 {print $4}')"
test "$available_kib" -gt 65536
initial_kib=$((available_kib - 1024))
fallocate -l "${initial_kib}K" "$target"
while dd if=/dev/zero of="$target" bs=64K count=1 oflag=append conv=notrunc status=none 2>/dev/null; do
  :
done
sync
used_percent="$(df -Pk /srv/archive | awk 'NR == 2 {gsub(/%/, "", $5); print $5}')"
test "$used_percent" -eq 100
if runuser -u archiveapp -- sh -c 'dd if=/dev/zero of=/srv/archive/incoming/.prepare-write-probe bs=1M count=1 conv=fsync status=none' 2>/dev/null; then
  rm -f /srv/archive/incoming/.prepare-write-probe
  exit 1
fi
rm -f /srv/archive/incoming/.prepare-write-probe
